The story

The world keeps shifting. Only the kids notice.

It’s 2095 in the San Francisco Bay Area. Sassafras, Theo, Murakami and Teeny are Finders, a messy, hilarious crew who track down food for their community.

But the world keeps glitching overnight, and every morning they wake up to a different version of it. So they set out to find who’s behind it. (Spoiler: it’s us, now.)

Like young people today, whose climate anxiety comes from feeling powerless, the Finders are facing a world they can’t control and must find a way to believe their actions can matter.

Grounding this story

Shape the story from the start.

Most impact campaigns start after a story is finished. Ours starts before it’s written. Clinicians, scientists and audiences help shape The Dial while it’s still taking form, so what we want audiences to be able to do is built into every door, and the webtoon, series, games and live event all share one world.

Early storyboard pages for the webtoon. Four episodes are already scripted.

The flywheel

One core story. Every door runs on it.

Ryzo builds franchises with multiple ways in, multiple planes of impact and multiple opportunities to act. Every part of the flywheel is a chance for fans to practice agency, and every door draws on the same core.

The core story

The world of 2095, the Finders, and the rules of how today shapes their tomorrow. Built once and shared by the webtoon, the series, the games and the live event.

The impact driver and metrics

The one move every door teaches: you can trace a change in the future back to an action taken now. But to act, you first have to face what you feel, hold onto a hope that’s honest, and find others to act with. Research on young people and climate anxiety points to exactly this mix. We will use these funds to transform that research into systems of action that run through every door, each with a defined metric that tells us whether audiences are making that move.

Watch

See your story reflected in the Finders.

Play

Learn the moves that create change in the Finders’ world and your own.

Make

Participate in the story through live events and at-home actions.

How we’ll know it works

Views are the start. We measure what changes.

Every platform moves fans along one arc: meet the story, believe the future can change, then act on it together. The webtoon, series, games and live event each carry audiences a step further, and we measure every step.

  1. 1

    Reach

    Who meets the Finders, and who comes back for more.

  2. 2

    Agency

    Who comes to see that the future can still change, and that they have a part in it.

  3. 3

    Action

    Who takes real steps, together, in their own lives.

We’ll report in the standard formats impact investors use. We plan to measure from day one, with parental consent for under-13s.

The ask

$150,000 to build the core, and prove it with a first audience.

A storyworld and an impact driver only become real when audiences meet them. So this raise does both: it builds the core, then puts it in front of readers through a webtoon, so we learn what lands before a single episode of the series is made.

First, build it

$70,000

The core storyworld, impact driver and metrics

  • Story Jams that bring climate scientists, psychologists, audiences and creatives into one room to find the storyworld
  • Climate research, and visual and thematic development
  • The Franchise Bible: world, characters and the rules of change
  • Defining a game mechanic that integrates the storyworld and practice opportunities together
  • Impact design and measurement that seek out what audiences need to reach for next

The hardest part, and the part that decides whether everything after it works.

Then, prove it with readers

$50,000

The webtoon: the core’s first audience

  • The storyworld’s first public form, written straight from the Franchise Bible. Four episodes are already scripted
  • Where we first see whether the impact driver lands with audiences, and try out the metrics on real readers
  • What readers tell us goes back into the core before the series, games and live event are built on it
  • Builds the initial audience every later door launches into

Turns the core from a document into a story audiences have actually read and answered.

Alongside, prototype fast

$30,000

Talk to the Future: tools that connect fans to the characters and the themes

  • Fast prototypes of tools that let the Finders talk to the fans
  • We’ll explore fun, story-centered experiences designed to amplify human connection, creative problem solving and confidence in taking on big issues
  • Built on what we’re learning from Talk to the Stans in our first franchise: character-driven AI experiences that draw audiences into real dialogue about what you can do when circumstances feel immovable and overwhelming

Small, fast tests that show which tools are worth building.

Build the coreWebtoonPrototypes
Each piece can be funded on its own, in whole or in part.$150,000 total

What this doesn’t pay for. Series production and the games are financed separately, by franchise investors and publishing partners. Your gift builds the core they all depend on, and the audience they launch into.
